mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5pp in 3 months), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market without overheating (UNRATE > 4.5%), boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (positive returns when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls with UNRATE>4.5%) fails in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% signals an overheating economy that triggers Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.5% during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% over three months signals economic contraction, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts exceeding 2.0% over three months signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises > 2.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer demand supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
